pairs: Speak to the heart of Jerusalem,
For her malice has reached its end.
suscepit de manu Domini duplicia pro omnibus peccatis suis.
She has received double for all her sins from the hand of the Lord.
The voice of one crying out in the desert:
rectas facite in solitudine semitas Dei nostri.
Make straight the paths of our God, in a solitary place.
et omnis mons et collis humiliabitur,
and every mountain and hill will be brought low.
And the crooked will be straightened,
and the uneven will become level ways.
And the glory of the Lord will be revealed.
et videbit omnis caro pariter quod os Domini locutum est.
And all flesh together will see that the mouth of the Lord has spoken.”
et omnis gloria ejus quasi flos agri.
and all its glory is like the flower of the field.
Exsiccatum est fœnum, et cecidit flos,
The grass has dried up, and the flower has fallen.
quia spiritus Domini sufflavit in eo.
For the Spirit of the Lord has blown over it.
Truly, the people are like grass.
verbum autem Domini nostri manet in æternum.
But the Word of our Lord remains for eternity.”
lift up your voice with strength!
Say to the cities of Judah:
ecce Dominus Deus in fortitudine veniet,
Behold, the Lord God will arrive in strength,
and his arm will rule. Behold,
and his work is before him.
He will pasture his flock like a shepherd.
He will gather together the lambs with his arm,
and he will lift them up to his bosom,
and he himself will carry the very young.
Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand,
and who has weighed the heavens with his palm?
quis appendit tribus digitis molem terræ,
Who has suspended the mass of the earth with three fingers,
and who has weighed the mountains on a balance
and the hills on a scale?
Who has assisted the Spirit of the Lord?
Or who has been his counselor
and has revealed things to him?
and taught him the path of justice,
and revealed the way of understanding to him?
Behold, the nations are like a drop of water in a bucket,
et quasi momentum stateræ reputatæ sunt;
and they are considered as the smallest grain on a balance.
Behold, the islands are like a little dust.
Et Libanus non sufficiet ad succendendum,
And Lebanon will not be sufficient to start a fire,
et animalia ejus non sufficient ad holocaustum.
and its animals will not be sufficient for a burnt offering.
All the nations in his sight are as if they did not exist,
and they are considered by him as if they were nothingness
et quasi nihilum et inane reputatæ sunt ei.
Therefore, to whom would you liken God?
Or with what image would you replace him?
Should the workman cast a statue?
Or has the goldsmith formed it with gold,
or the silversmith with plates of silver?
He has chosen strong wood that will not decay.
artifex sapiens quærit quomodo statuat simulacrum, quod non moveatur.
The skillful artisan seeks a way to set up an idol that cannot be moved.
numquid non annuntiatum est vobis ab initio?
Has it not been announced to you from the beginning?
Have you not understood the foundations of the earth?
Qui sedet super gyrum terræ, et habitatores ejus sunt quasi locustæ;
He is the One who sits upon the globe of the earth, and its inhabitants are like locusts.
He extends the heavens as if they were nothing,
et expandit eos sicut tabernaculum ad inhabitandum;
and he spreads them out like a tent, in which to dwell.
qui dat secretorum scrutatores quasi non sint,
He has brought those who examine what is secret to nothingness.
He has brought the judges of the earth to emptiness.
neque radicatus in terra truncus eorum;
He has suddenly blown across them,
et turbo quasi stipulam auferet eos.
and a whirlwind will carry them away like chaff.
“And to whom would you compare me
Levate in excelsum oculos vestros, et videte quis creavit hæc:
Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these things.
qui educit in numero militiam eorum,
He leads forth their army by number,
and he calls them all by name.
præ multitudine fortitudinis et roboris, virtutisque ejus,
Because of the fullness of his strength and robustness and virtue,
not one of them was left behind.
and why do you speak this way,
Abscondita est via mea a Domino,
“My way has been hidden from the Lord,
et a Deo meo judicium meum transivit?
and my judgment escaped notice by my God.”
The Lord is the eternal God,
who has created the limits of the earth.
It is he who gives strength to the weary,
and it is he who increases fortitude
and strength in those who are failing.
and young men will fall into infirmity.
qui autem sperant in Domino mutabunt fortitudinem,
But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength.
They will take up wings like eagles.
They will run and not struggle.
They will walk and not tire.
